cross_references.note: VICP §300aa-22(b)(1) (per Bruesewitz) preempts Greenman strict liability and Barker design defect claims against vaccine MANUFACTURERS. Does NOT apply to Walgreens as administering party.
Bruesewitz fully preempts Barker design defect against vaccine manufacturers. Barker applies to Walgreens only for non-vaccine device defects (syringe, needle manufacturer).

VICP preemption analysis is the gateway: once confirmed Walgreens is not a manufacturer, the claim routes to SIRVA negligent administration doctrine (CA_Medical_Malpractice_Litigator). These standards must be read together for the Walgreens claim.

VICP 3-year petition filing deadline runs from first symptom. Civil action against Walgreens (post-VICP failure or parallel): CCP §335.1 (2-year personal injury). Check whether VICP filing window is closed.
